scope: Addendum to Luna V2 only: read-only verification of the diagnostic crosswalk rename. No tests rerun, no admission/review issued, and no actual election results used.

resolvedFinding.priorCaveat: Crosswalk field nativeCandidateId could imply that an outside-pair official-winner diagnostic key was a modeled/native forecast candidate ID.
resolvedFinding.currentContract: candidateCrosswalk.candidateKey is the identity key used to bind count-map keys; pair keys are exact native forecast candidate IDs, while any extra diagnostic key is a separately reviewed source-person identity, not a modeled outcome.
resolvedFinding.evidence: The admission type and all validation lookups use candidateKey. The synthetic outside-pair test identity is explicitly INVENTED:outside-pair and is bound to a source locator; no legal-winner grading path is enabled.
resolvedFinding.assessment: The naming ambiguity is resolved. The earlier V2 approval remains qualified by its stated scope; this addendum only supersedes the caveat, not unrelated source review or admission requirements.

testStatus: Parent reports updated admission tests pass 8/8; this addendum did not rerun them.
